captions.instagram:
You're tired, but your mind won't switch off. 🌙

The message you sent, the work you didn't finish, what everyone else is doing.
At night every thought feels urgent. Almost none of them are.
One slow breath in, a longer one out. The rest can wait till morning.

Save this for the next 1 a.m.

#overthinking #sleep #gentlereminder #soundmind
